definitions.explanation: Consisting of only one kind, element, or component. Emphasizes uniformity or the absence of variety or complexity.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {単一|たんいつ}⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧ (single ethnicity)
- {単一|たんいつ}⟦{通貨|つうか}→通貨：03508_tsuuka⟧ (single currency)
- {単一|たんいつ}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (single market)
- {単一|たんいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧ (single standard)

USAGE:
Used as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective to modify nouns: {単一|たんいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ or {単一|たんいつ}～ (without ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ in compound nouns like {単一|たんいつ}⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧). Often contrasted with ⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧ (multiple) or ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧ (diverse). More formal than ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, and emphasizes the concept of uniformity rather than just the number one.
